component.name: HomeScene
component.script:
sub init() print "CLEANYOURROKU STARTED" m.ch = loadMyChannel() ' The first tile opens My Channel. Its label is "name" from mychannel.json. m.apps = [ [m.ch.name, "mychannel"], ["YouTube", "837"], ["Netflix", "12"], ["Hulu", "2285"], ["Starz", "65067"], ["Pluto TV", "74519"], ["Tubi", "41468"], ["NFL", "44856"], ["Prime Video", "13"], ["Frndly TV", "298229"], ["NBA", "73249"], ["Plex", "13535"], ["Roku Media Player", "2213"], ["Vevo", "20445"], ["iHeart", "20197"], ["TuneIn", "1453"], ["6abc Philadelphia", "583225"], ["TV Cast", "58621"], ["Jellyfin", "592369"], ["ESPN", "34376"], ["Peacock", "593099"] ] content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each a in m.apps item = content.CreateChild("ContentNode") item.title = a[0] if a[1] = "mychannel" then item.HDPosterUrl = m.ch.tileImage else item.HDPosterUrl = "pkg:/images/app_" + a[1] + ".png" end if end for m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") m.grid.content = content m.grid.setFocus(true) m.launcher = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Launcher") m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.fs = CreateObject("roFileSystem")
' My Channel: a section only shows up if mychannel.json has content for it m.sections = [] if m.ch.family.Count() > 0 then m.sections.Push({ title: "Family", kind: "family" }) if m.ch.photos.Count() > 0 then m.sections.Push({ title: "Photos", kind: "photos" }) if m.ch.videos.Count() > 0 then m.sections.Push({ title: "Videos", kind: "videos" }) if m.ch.recipes.Count() > 0 then m.sections.Push({ title: "Recipes", kind: "recipes" }) if m.ch.music.Count() > 0 then m.sections.Push({ title: "Music", kind: "music" }) if m.ch.links.Count() > 0 then m.sections.Push({ title: "Links", kind: "links" }) m.sections.Push({ title: "About", kind: "about" }) m.pos = { photos: 0, links: 0, videos: 0, music: 0, recipes: 0, family: 0 } m.kind = m.sections[0].kind mc = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each sec in m.sections mn = mc.CreateChild("ContentNode") mn.title = sec.title end for m.channel = m.top.findNode("channel") m.menu = m.top.findNode("menu") m.menu.content = mc m.menu.observeField("itemFocused", "showSection") m.menu.observeField("itemSelected", "onMenuSelect") m.top.findNode("chName").text = m.ch.name m.top.findNode("chTagline").text = m.ch.tagline for each id in ["aboutView", "aboutPhoto", "aboutName", "aboutBio", "photosView", "photo", "caption", "photoCount", "linksView", "qr", "qrMissing", "linkLabel", "linkUrl", "linkCount", "videosView", "videoThumb", "videoTitle", "videoInfo", "videoCount", "hint", "video"] m[id] = m.top.findNode(id) end for m.aboutPhoto.uri = m.ch.aboutPhoto m.aboutName.text = m.ch.aboutName m.aboutBio.text = m.ch.bio m.keys = m.top.createChild("Group") m.keys.focusable = true buildRecipes() buildFamily() m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.audio = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Audio") m.top.appendChild(m.audio) m.audio.observeField("state", "onAudioState") m.audio.notificationInterval = 1 m.audio.observeField("position", "onSongTime") m.status = m.top.findNode("musicView").createChild("Label") m.status.translation = [540, 805] m.status.width = 1080 m.status.horizAlign = "center" m.status.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" m.panelOn = false m.pf = 3 m.slide = false m.full = false m.fullBg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.fullBg.width = 1920 m.fullBg.height = 1080 m.fullBg.color = "0x000000FF" m.fullBg.visible = false m.fullPhoto = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.fullPhoto.width = 1920 m.fullPhoto.height = 1080 m.fullPhoto.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" m.fullPhoto.visible = false m.slideTimer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.slideTimer.duration = 1 m.left = 5 m.fullCount = m.top.createChild("Label") m.fullCount.translation = [1500, 1000] m.fullCount.width = 380 m.fullCount.horizAlign = "right" m.fullCount.color = "0xFFFFFFCC" m.fullCount.visible = false m.slideTimer.repeat = true m.slideTimer.observeField("fire", "onSlide") m.musicOn = false m.curSong = -1 end sub
' Reads pkg:/mychannel.json. Missing fields fall back to blanks, so a typo shows a message instead of crashing. function loadMyChannel() as Object ch = { name: "My Channel", tagline: "", tileImage: "pkg:/images/app_uxd_s.jpg", aboutName: "", aboutPhoto: "", bio: "", photos: [], links: [], videos: [], music: [], recipes: [], family: [] } raw = ReadAsciiFile("pkg:/mychannel.json") cfg = invalid if raw <> "" then cfg = ParseJson(raw) if type(cfg) <> "roAssociativeArray" then ch.bio = "Couldn't read mychannel.json. Check it for a missing comma or quote, then rebuild the zip and reinstall." return ch end if if getText(cfg, "name") <> "" then ch.name = getText(cfg, "name") if getText(cfg, "tile_image") <> "" then ch.tileImage = getText(cfg, "tile_image") ch.tagline = getText(cfg, "tagline") ch.aboutName = getText(cfg.about, "name") ch.aboutPhoto = getText(cfg.about, "photo") ch.bio = getText(cfg.about, "bio") ch.photos = getList(cfg, "photos") ch.links = getList(cfg, "links") ch.videos = getList(cfg, "videos") ch.music = getList(cfg, "music") ch.recipes = getList(cfg, "recipes") ch.family = getList(cfg, "family") return ch end function
function getText(aa as Dynamic, key as String) as String if type(aa) = "roAssociativeArray" then v = aa[key] if type(v) = "roString" or type(v) = "String" then return v end if return "" end function
function getList(aa as Dynamic, key as String) as Object if type(aa) = "roAssociativeArray" and type(aa[key]) = "roArray" then return aa[key] return [] end function
function counter(i as Integer, n as Integer) as String return Str(i + 1).Trim() + " / " + Str(n).Trim() end function
sub showSection() i = m.menu.itemFocused if i < 0 or i >= m.sections.Count() then i = 0 m.kind = m.sections[i].kind m.aboutView.visible = (m.kind = "about") m.photosView.visible = false m.linksView.visible = (m.kind = "links") m.videosView.visible = false m.top.findNode("musicView").visible = (m.kind = "music") m.rView.visible = (m.kind = "recipes" or m.kind = "videos" or m.kind = "photos") if m.famView <> invalid then m.famView.visible = (m.kind = "family") if m.kind = "about" then m.hint.text = "Up/Down: sections Back: home" else if m.kind = "family" then drawFamily() else if m.kind = "photos_old" then p = m.ch.photos[m.pos.photos] m.photo.uri = getText(p, "image") m.caption.text = getText(p, "caption") m.photoCount.text = counter(m.pos.photos, m.ch.photos.Count()) + slideTag() placeIcon(m.photoCount) m.hint.text = "Play: Slideshow OK: Full screen Left/Right: Browse" else if m.kind = "links" then l = m.ch.links[m.pos.links] qr = "pkg:/images/mychannel/qr_" + getText(l, "id") + ".png" if true then m.qr.uri = qr m.qrMissing.visible = false else m.qr.uri = "" m.qrMissing.visible = true end if m.linkLabel.text = getText(l, "label") link = getText(l, "link") if Left(link, 5) = "WIFI:" then link = "Scan with your phone camera to join." m.linkUrl.text = link m.linkCount.text = counter(m.pos.links, m.ch.links.Count()) + slideTag() placeIcon(m.linkCount) m.hint.text = "Play: Slideshow OK: Full screen Left/Right: Browse" else if m.kind = "recipes" or m.kind = "videos" or m.kind = "photos" then setColl(m.kind) drawRecipe() else if m.kind = "music" then if m.musicOn and m.curSong <> m.pos.music then playSong() sg = m.ch.music[m.pos.music] m.top.findNode("musicTitle").text = getText(sg, "title") if getText(sg, "record") <> "" then m.top.findNode("record").uri = getText(sg, "record") m.top.findNode("panel").uri = "pkg:/images/mychannel/panel_" + Stri(m.pos.music + 1).Trim() + ".png" st = getText(sg, "length") stat = "Press OK to play" if m.musicOn and m.curSong = m.pos.music then st = songLeft() stat = "" if m.audio.state = "paused" then stat = "Paused" end if m.top.findNode("musicInfo").text = getText(sg, "artist") + " · Song " + counter(m.pos.music, m.ch.music.Count()) + " · " + st m.status.text = stat m.status.color = getText(sg, "color") m.hint.text = "Press Right for controls. Colored buttons are on-screen only." ml = m.top.findNode("modeLabel") ml.text = modeName() w = ml.boundingRect().width x = 1767 - (30 + 10 + w) / 2 m.top.findNode("modeIcon").translation = [x, 920] ml.translation = [x + 40, 921] else if m.kind = "videos" then v = m.ch.videos[m.pos.videos] m.videoTitle.text = getText(v, "title") m.top.findNode("videoThumb").uri = getText(v, "thumb") first = Int(m.pos.videos / 5) * 5 for i = 0 to 4 card = m.top.findNode("card" + i.ToStr()) if first + i < m.ch.videos.Count() then card.uri = getText(m.ch.videos[first + i], "thumb") card.visible = true else card.visible = false end if end for m.top.findNode("cardFocus").translation = [655 + (m.pos.videos - first) * 220, 735] if getText(v, "url") = "" then m.videoInfo.text = "No video link yet. Add a direct MP4 link for this video in mychannel.json." else m.videoInfo.text = getText(v, "length") + " · Press OK to play" end if m.videoCount.text = counter(m.pos.videos, m.ch.videos.Count()) m.hint.text = "Left/Right: choose a video OK: play Back: home" end if end sub
' Left/Right move through photos, links or videos. Stops at the ends instead of wrapping. sub browse(d as Integer) if m.kind = "about" then return i = m.pos[m.kind] + d if i < 0 or i >= m.ch[m.kind].Count() then return m.pos[m.kind] = i showSection() end sub
sub onMenuSelect() if m.kind = "family" then famEnter() if m.kind = "videos" then playRecipeVideo() if m.kind = "music" then toggleMusic() if m.kind = "links" then toggleFull() if m.kind = "photos" then playRecipeVideo() if m.kind = "recipes" then playRecipeVideo() end sub
sub playVideo() stopMusic() if m.video.visible then return v = m.ch.videos[m.pos.videos] if getText(v, "url") = "" then return c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") c.url = getText(v, "url") c.title = getText(v, "title") c.streamFormat = "mp4" if Instr(1, c.url, ".m3u8") > 0 then c.streamFormat = "hls" m.video.content = c m.video.visible = true m.video.setFocus(true) m.video.control = "play" end sub
sub onVideoState() if m.video.state = "playing" and m.tipWait = true then m.tipWait = false if m.side <> true then showSideTip() end if if m.video.state = "error" then msg = m.video.errorMsg closeVideo() m.videoInfo.text = "Couldn't play this video (" + msg + "). Check that the link goes straight to an .mp4 file." else if m.video.state = "finished" then closeVideo() end if end sub
sub closeVideo() closeVideoCore() if m.rVidBack = true then m.rVidBack = false fc = m.rVidCard pn = m.rVidPanel openRecipeFull() m.rFCard = fc m.rPanel = pn showRecipeFull() else if m.rOn then m.keys.setFocus(true) else if m.kind = "family" and m.fmOn then m.keys.setFocus(true) drawFamily() end if end sub
sub sideBuild() par = m.video.getParent() m.sideBg = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") m.sideBg.width = 1920 m.sideBg.height = 1080 m.sideBg.color = "0x000000FF" idx = 0 for i = 0 to par.getChildCount() - 1 if par.getChild(i).isSameNode(m.video) then idx = i end for par.insertChild(m.sideBg, idx) m.sideG = m.top.createChild("Group") m.sVid = m.sideG.createChild("Label") m.sVid.translation = [0, 0] m.sVid.width = 1920 m.sVid.horizAlign = "center" m.sVid.height = 75 m.sVid.vertAlign = "center" m.sVid.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" m.sVid.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.sNav = m.sideG.createChild("Label") m.sNav.translation = [1260, 893] m.sNav.width = 420 m.sNav.height = 40 m.sNav.horizAlign = "right" m.sNav.vertAlign = "center" m.sNav.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.sNav.color = "0x9FC6F0FF" m.sHead = m.sideG.createChild("Label") m.sHead.translation = [240, 893] m.sHead.width = 1000 m.sHead.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" m.sHead.color = "0xF0BE3CFF" m.sBody = m.sideG.createChild("Label") m.sBody.translation = [240, 930] m.sBody.width = 1000 m.sBody.height = 100 m.sBody.wrap = true m.sBody.maxLines = 2 m.sBody.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" m.sBody.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.sHint = m.sideG.createChild("Label") m.sHint.translation = [0, 1035] m.sHint.width = 1920 m.sHint.height = 40 m.sHint.horizAlign = "center" m.sHint.font = "font:SmallestSystemFont" m.sHint.color = "0x9A9A9AFF" m.sHint.text = "Left/Right: Story OK: Pause Up or Back: Full screen" end sub
sub sideOn() if m.side = true then return if m.sideG = invalid then sideBuild() m.side = true m.sCard = 1 m.vT = m.video.translation m.vW = m.video.width m.vH = m.video.height m.video.translation = [240, 75] m.video.width = 1440 m.video.height = 810 m.sideBg.visible = true m.sideG.visible = true m.keys.setFocus(true) hideSideTip() drawSide() m.video.observeField("position", "onSidePos") end sub
sub onSidePos() if m.side = true then drawSide() end sub
function stepName() as String if m.coll <> "recipes" then return "story" return "recipe" end function
function fmtTime(t as Integer) as String if t < 0 then t = 0 sec = t mod 60 if sec < 10 then ss = "0" + Stri(sec).Trim() else ss = Stri(sec).Trim() return Stri(Int(t / 60)).Trim() + ":" + ss end function
sub showSideTip() if m.tip = invalid then m.tipBg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.tipBg.translation = [1380, 60] m.tipBg.width = 480 m.tipBg.height = 70 m.tipBg.color = "0x000000C0" m.tip = m.top.createChild("Label") m.tip.translation = [1380, 60] m.tip.width = 480 m.tip.height = 70 m.tip.horizAlign = "center" m.tip.vertAlign = "center" m.tip.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" m.tip.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.tip.text = "Press Down for side view" m.tipTimer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.tipTimer.duration = 4 m.tipTimer.observeField("fire", "hideSideTip") end if m.tipBg.visible = true m.tip.visible = true m.tipTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub hideSideTip() if m.tip <> invalid then m.tip.visible = false m.tipBg.visible = false end if end sub
sub sideOff() if m.side <> true then return m.side = false m.video.unobserveField("position") m.video.translation = m.vT m.video.width = m.vW m.video.height = m.vH m.sideBg.visible = false m.sideG.visible = false end sub
sub drawSide() r = curRecipe() if r = invalid then return cards = recipeCards(r) m.sMax = cards.Count() - 2 if m.sMax < 0 then m.sMax = 0 if m.sCard < 1 then m.sCard = 1 if m.sCard > m.sMax then m.sCard = m.sMax c = cards[m.sCard] top = "" for each k in ["category", "title", "season", "date"] if getText(r, k) <> "" then if top <> "" then top = top + " · " top = top + getText(r, k) end if end for if getText(r, "filmedBy") <> "" then top = top + " · Filmed by " + getText(r, "filmedBy") m.sVid.text = top m.sHead.text = c.title m.sBody.text = c.body tl = getText(r, "length") if m.video.duration > 0 then tl = fmtTime(Int(m.video.duration - m.video.position)) + " left" m.sNav.text = "Story " + Stri(m.sCard).Trim() + " / " + Stri(m.sMax).Trim() + " · " + tl end sub
sub closeVideoCore() m.tipWait = false hideSideTip() sideOff() m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false m.menu.setFocus(true) end sub
sub openChannel() m.grid.visible = false m.title.visible = false m.channel.visible = true m.menu.setFocus(true) showSection() end sub
sub closeChannel() m.rOn = false m.rCard = -1 stopMusic() stopSlide() m.channel.visible = false m.grid.visible = true m.title.visible = true m.grid.setFocus(true) end sub
sub toggleMusic() if m.ch.music.Count() = 0 then return if m.tapClock <> invalid and m.tapClock.TotalMilliseconds() < 500 then return m.tapClock = CreateObject("roTimespan") if m.musicOn and m.curSong = m.pos.music then if m.audio.state = "paused" then m.audio.control = "resume" m.top.findNode("spin").control = "start" else m.audio.control = "pause" m.top.findNode("spin").control = "stop" m.top.findNode("record").rotation = 0 end if else playSong() end if showSection() end sub
sub playSong() sg = m.ch.music[m.pos.music] c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") c.url = getText(sg, "url") c.title = getText(sg, "title") c.streamFormat = "mp3" m.audio.content = c m.audio.control = "play" m.musicOn = true m.curSong = m.pos.music m.top.findNode("spin").control = "start" end sub
sub stopMusic() if m.audio <> invalid then m.audio.control = "stop" m.musicOn = false m.curSong = -1 sp = m.top.findNode("spin") if sp <> invalid then sp.control = "stop" end sub
sub enterPanel() m.panelOn = true m.pf = 3 m.keys.setFocus(true) updatePanel() end sub
sub exitPanel() m.panelOn = false m.top.findNode("pfRing").visible = false m.menu.setFocus(true) end sub
sub updatePanel() r = m.top.findNode("pfRing") r.visible = m.panelOn r.translation = [1661 + m.pf * 42, 830] end sub
sub pressPanel(i as Integer) n = m.ch.music.Count() if n = 0 then return if i = 0 then if m.mode = invalid or m.mode = "all" then m.mode = "one" else if m.mode = "one" then m.mode = "shuffle" else m.mode = "all" end if else if i = 1 then playSong() else if i = 2 then m.pos.music = (m.pos.music - 1 + n) MOD n playSong() else if i = 3 then toggleMusic() return else if i = 4 then m.pos.music = (m.pos.music + 1) MOD n playSong() end if showSection() end sub
sub toggleSlide() if m.slide then stopSlide() else m.slide = true m.left = 5 m.slideTimer.control = "start" showSection() end if end sub
sub stopSlide() m.slide = false if m.slideTimer <> invalid then m.slideTimer.control = "stop" if (m.kind = "photos" or m.kind = "links") and m.channel.visible then showSection() end sub
sub onSlide() if (m.kind <> "photos" and m.kind <> "links") or not m.channel.visible then stopSlide() return end if if m.left > 1 then m.left = m.left - 1 else m.left = 5 m.pos[m.kind] = (m.pos[m.kind] + 1) MOD m.ch[m.kind].Count() end if showSection() if m.full then m.fullPhoto.uri = fullUri() end sub
function slideTag() as String if m.fullCount <> invalid then m.fullCount.visible = m.full and m.slide m.fullCount.text = nextWord() + " in " + Stri(m.left).Trim() end if if m.photoLaid = invalid then m.photoLaid = true ct = m.caption.translation pt = m.photo.translation m.caption.translation = [ct[0], pt[1] - 70] m.photoCount.translation = [ct[0], ct[1]] m.photoCount.width = 1080 m.photoCount.horizAlign = "center" end if if m.slideLine <> invalid then m.slideLine.text = "" if m.slide then return " · " + nextWord() + " in " + Stri(m.left).Trim() return " · Play" end function
function fullUri() as String if m.fullLabel <> invalid then if m.kind = "links" then m.fullLabel.text = m.linkLabel.text else m.fullLabel.text = "" end if if m.kind = "links" then m.fullPhoto.width = 820 m.fullPhoto.height = 820 m.fullPhoto.translation = [550, 160] return m.qr.uri end if m.fullPhoto.width = 1920 m.fullPhoto.height = 1080 m.fullPhoto.translation = [0, 0] return m.photo.uri end function
function nextWord() as String if m.kind = "links" then return "Next link" return "Next photo" end function
sub placeIcon(lb as Object) if m.icons = invalid then m.icons = {} k = lb.id if m.icons[k] = invalid then ic = lb.getParent().createChild("Poster") ic.width = 28 ic.height = 28 m.icons[k] = ic end if ic = m.icons[k] if m.measure = invalid then m.measure = m.top.createChild("Label") m.measure.visible = false end if m.measure.font = lb.font m.measure.text = lb.text w = m.measure.boundingRect().width h = m.measure.boundingRect().height t = lb.translation x = t[0] + w + 16 if lb.width > 0 and lb.horizAlign = "center" then x = t[0] + (lb.width - w) / 2 + w + 16 if lb.width > 0 and lb.horizAlign = "right" then x = t[0] + lb.width - w - 44 ic.translation = [x, t[1] + (h - 28) / 2] if m.slide then ic.uri = "pkg:/images/mychannel/pause_icon.png" else ic.uri = "pkg:/images/mychannel/play_icon.png" end sub
sub toggleFull() if m.fullClock <> invalid and m.fullClock.TotalMilliseconds() < 500 then return m.fullClock = CreateObject("roTimespan") m.full = true if m.fullLabel = invalid then m.fullLabel = m.top.createChild("Label") m.fullLabel.translation = [0, 30] m.fullLabel.width = 1920 m.fullLabel.horizAlign = "center" m.fullLabel.font = "font:LargeBoldSystemFont" m.fullLabel.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" end if m.fullLabel.visible = true m.fullPhoto.uri = fullUri() m.fullBg.visible = true m.fullPhoto.visible = true m.keys.setFocus(true) end sub
sub exitFull() if m.fullClock <> invalid and m.fullClock.TotalMilliseconds() < 500 then return m.fullClock = CreateObject("roTimespan") m.full = false m.fullBg.visible = false m.fullPhoto.visible = false m.fullCount.visible = false if m.fullLabel <> invalid then m.fullLabel.visible = false m.menu.setFocus(true) end sub
function songLeft() as String d = m.audio.duration if d = invalid or d <= 0 then ln = getText(m.ch.music[m.curSong], "length") c = Instr(1, ln, ":") if c = 0 then return "Now playing" d = Val(Left(ln, c - 1)) * 60 + Val(Mid(ln, c + 1)) end if r = Int(d - m.audio.position) if r < 0 then r = 0 sec = r MOD 60 ss = Stri(sec).Trim() if sec < 10 then ss = "0" + ss return "-" + Stri(Int(r / 60)).Trim() + ":" + ss end function
sub onSongTime() if m.kind = "music" and m.channel.visible and m.musicOn then showSection() end sub
' ===== Family Tree ===== function fmCats() as Object return ["Everyone", "Grandparents", "Parents", "Aunts & Uncles", "Cousins", "Kids", "Friends", "In Memory"] end function
function fmList() as Object cat = fmCats()[m.fmCat] out = [] for each p in m.ch.family ok = false if m.fmCat = 0 then ok = true else if cat = "In Memory" then ok = (getText(p, "died") <> "") else ok = (getText(p, "group") = cat) end if if ok then out.Push(p) end for return out end function
function fmAvatar(p as Object) as String if getText(p, "photo") <> "" then return getText(p, "photo") if getText(p, "avatar") = "f" then return "pkg:/images/mychannel/avatar_f.png" return "pkg:/images/mychannel/avatar_m.png" end function
function fmYears(p as Object) as String b = getText(p, "born") d = getText(p, "died") if d <> "" then return Right(b, 4) + " – " + Right(d, 4) if b <> "" then return "Born " + b return "" end function
function nextBirthday() as String months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"] dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() today = dt.GetMonth() * 32 + dt.GetDayOfMonth() best = 9999 who = "" when = "" for each p in m.ch.family b = getText(p, "born") if b <> "" and getText(p, "died") = "" then parts = b.Split(" ") if parts.Count() >= 2 then mi = 0 for i = 0 to 11 if months[i] = parts[0] then mi = i + 1 end for d = Val(parts[1].Replace(",", "")) if mi > 0 then k = mi * 32 + d - today if k < 0 then k = k + 13 * 32 if k < best then best = k who = getText(p, "name") when = parts[0] + " " + Stri(d).Trim() end if end if end if end if end for if who = "" then return "" if best = 0 then return "Birthday today: " + who + "!" return "Next birthday: " + who + " · " + when end function
sub buildFamily() m.fmOn = false m.fmFoc = "row" m.fmPop = false m.fmPi = 0 m.fmCat = 0 m.fmGrid = false m.fmProf = false m.fmOb = 0 m.fmBig = false m.fpTab = 0 m.fpSel = 0 m.fpFoc = "body" m.fpPi = 0 function fmTagged(p as Object, kind as String) as Object nm = getText(p, "name") out = [] for each it in m.ch[kind] hit = false for each t in getList(it, "people") if t = nm then hit = true end for if not hit and nm <> "" and Instr(1, getText(it, "who"), nm) > 0 then hit = true if hit then out.Push(it) end for return out end function
function fpTabList(p as Object) as Object tabs = ["Profile"] for each t in ["Photos", "Videos", "Recipes", "Music"] if fmTagged(p, LCase(t)).Count() > 0 then tabs.Push(t) end for return tabs end function

1 else if key = "down" then if m.fmPi + 1 < cc then m.fmPi = m.fmPi + 1 else if key = "OK" then oldCat = m.fmCat m.fmCat = m.fmPi if fmList().Count() = 0 then m.fmCat = oldCat else m.pos.family = 0 m.fmPop = false m.fmFoc = "row" end if else if key = "back" then m.fmPop = false end if drawFamily() return true end if if m.fmFoc = "cat" then if key = "OK" then m.fmPop = true m.fmPi = m.fmCat else if key = "down" then m.fmFoc = "row" else if key = "back" then famExit() return true end if drawFamily() return true end if if key = "left" then if m.pos.family > 0 then m.pos.family = m.pos.family -
